name: snippy
description: Snippy monorepo - Angular frontend and PocketBase.

scripts.check:all: npm run check:audit && npm run check:format && npm run check:types && npm run check:build && npm run check:test
scripts.test:all: npm run check:test && npm run test --prefix snippy/frontend
scripts.docker:compose:clear: docker compose down -v && docker compose build && docker compose up
scripts.docker:compose:up: docker compose build && docker compose up
